opening.argument: The presentation ties paid cryptocurrency packages to earnings that depend on recruitment and continued participation. It says, "if you invite others you're gonna make a whole lot more money," then directs viewers to "get six people to follow you within this system six people to commit." Compensation is further structured around higher levels, since "you have to be a pro trader," while the package and network strategy are linked to the claim that "those tokens are going to turn into one coins." Alongside multiple accounts, escalating purchases, and a blueprint to reach $100,000 in six months, this presents cash flow and token growth as products of recruiting and further payments—not an ordinary standalone sale.
